2.  **Spot/Patch Count per Giraffe:** Giraffe spots (technically dark polyphenic patches) vary significantly by subspecies.
    *   **Masai Giraffes** (the largest wild population, ~50-60%): These have larger, leaf-shaped spots. An average adult has approximately **300–350** distinct dark patches.

3.  **Calculation:** $110,000 \text{ (giraffes)} \times 370 \text{ (spots/giraffe)} = 40,700,000$.
